arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent verification of the normalization batch.

This script does NOT import normalize.py. It re-reads the rules, re-scans the
dropbox, and independently re-derives what the artifacts must contain, then
checks:

  * index.csv / reject_ledger.csv headers, sorting and allowed values
  * normalized JSON key sets, types and filename pattern
  * one normalized file per accepted record, none per rejected record
  * totals in batch_summary.json
  * full coverage of input files by exactly one ledger family
  * an explicit expectation table for this fixture (accepted ids, rejects)
  * idempotency snapshot comparison (optional, via --snapshot)

Exit code 0 = all checks pass.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
DROPBOX = WS / "dropbox"
NORMALIZED = WS / "normalized"
INDEX = WS / "index.csv"
REJECTS = WS / "reject_ledger.csv"
SUMMARY = WS / "batch_summary.json"

ALLOWED_ERRORS = {
    "unsupported_extension",
    "malformed_file",
    "missing_required_field",
    "invalid_status",
    "invalid_amount",
    "duplicate_record_id",
}

DOMAIN_STATUS = {"active", "inactive", "pending", "open", "closed"}
ORDER_STATUS = "active"

EXPECTED_KEYS = {
    "customer": {"record_id", "record_type", "name", "email", "status"},
    "order": {"record_id", "record_type", "customer_id", "amount", "currency", "status"},
    "note": {"record_id", "record_type", "owner", "status"},
}

# Hand-derived from the fixture files, independent of the pipeline's logic.
EXPECTED_ACCEPT = {
    "dropbox/customers/customers_01.csv": ["C-001", "C-002"],
    "dropbox/customers/customers_extra.csv": ["C-003"],
    "dropbox/notes/case_500.txt": ["CASE-500"],
    "dropbox/notes/case_501.txt": ["CASE-501"],
    "dropbox/notes/case_502.txt": ["CASE-502"],
    "dropbox/orders/2026/order_100.json": ["O-100"],
    "dropbox/orders/2026/order_101.JSON": ["O-101"],
    "dropbox/orders/2026/order_102.json": ["O-102"],
}

EXPECTED_REJECT = {
    "dropbox/customers/customers_bad.csv": ["invalid_status", "missing_required_field"],
    "dropbox/customers/customers_extra.csv": ["duplicate_record_id"],
    "dropbox/misc/empty.md": ["unsupported_extension"],
    "dropbox/misc/image.png": ["unsupported_extension"],
    "dropbox/notes/case_bad.txt": ["missing_required_field"],
    "dropbox/orders/2026/order_bad.json": ["invalid_amount"],
    "dropbox/orders/2026/order_dup.json": ["duplicate_record_id"],
    "dropbox/orders/2026/order_missing_currency.json": ["missing_required_field"],
}

# Independent value expectations for accepted records.
EXPECTED_VALUES = {
    "C-001": {"record_type": "customer", "name": "Ada Lovelace", "email": "SYNTHETIC_EMAIL_REDACTED", "status": "active"},
    "C-002": {"record_type": "customer", "name": "Lin Chen", "email": "SYNTHETIC_EMAIL_REDACTED", "status": "inactive"},
    "C-003": {"record_type": "customer", "name": "Mira Patel", "email": "SYNTHETIC_EMAIL_REDACTED", "status": "pending"},
    "O-100": {"record_type": "order", "customer_id": "C-001", "amount": 120.5, "currency": "USD", "status": "active"},
    "O-101": {"record_type": "order", "customer_id": "C-002", "amount": 88, "currency": "EUR", "status": "active"},
    "O-102": {"record_type": "order", "customer_id": "C-003", "amount": 42.75, "currency": "USD", "status": "active"},
    "CASE-500": {"record_type": "note", "owner": "ana", "status": "open"},
    "CASE-501": {"record_type": "note", "owner": "bo", "status": "closed"},
    "CASE-502": {"record_type": "note", "owner": "cy", "status": "pending"},
}

failures: list[str] = []
checks = 0


def check(condition: bool, message: str) -> bool:
    global checks
    checks += 1
    if not condition:
        failures.append(message)
    return condition


def load_rules() -> dict:
    rules = {}
    text = (WS / "normalization_rules.yaml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for line in text.splitlines():
        line = line.split("#", 1)[0].strip()
        if not line or ":" not in line:
            continue
        key, value = line.split(":", 1)
        key, value = key.strip(), value.strip()
        if value.startswith("[") and value.endswith("]"):
            rules[key] = [v.strip().strip("'\"") for v in value[1:-1].split(",") if v.strip()]
        elif value:
            rules[key] = value.strip("'\"")
    return rules


def read_csv(path: Path) -> tuple[list[str], list[dict]]:
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
        reader = csv.DictReader(fh)
        rows = list(reader)
        return list(reader.fieldnames or []), rows


def input_files() -> list[str]:
    return sorted(
        p.relative_to(WS).as_posix() for p in DROPBOX.rglob("*") if p.is_file()
    )


def main() -> int:
    rules = load_rules()
    statuses = set(rules["statuses"])
    output_name = rules["output_name"]
    pattern = re.compile(
        "^"
        + re.escape(output_name)
        .replace(r"\{record_type\}", "(?P<record_type>customer|order|note)")
        .replace(r"\{record_id\}", "(?P<record_id>.+)")
        + "$"
    )

    inputs = input_files()
    check(len(inputs) == 15, f"expected 15 input files, found {len(inputs)}")

    # ---------------- index.csv ----------------
    check(INDEX.is_file(), "index.csv missing")
    check(REJECTS.is_file(), "reject_ledger.csv missing")
    check(SUMMARY.is_file(), "batch_summary.json missing")
    if failures:
        print("FATAL: required artifacts missing")
        for f in failures:
            print("  -", f)
        return 1

    header, index_rows = read_csv(INDEX)
    check(
        header == ["source_path", "target_path", "record_type", "record_id", "status"],
        f"index.csv header mismatch: {header}",
    )
    check(
        all(re.fullmatch(r"[^,]+", row["source_path"]) for row in index_rows),
        "index.csv has malformed source_path value",
    )
    check(
        [r["source_path"] for r in index_rows] == sorted(r["source_path"] for r in index_rows),
        "index.csv rows are not sorted by source_path",
    )
    check(
        all(r["source_path"].startswith("dropbox/") for r in index_rows),
        "index.csv source_path is not workspace-relative under dropbox/",
    )
    statuses_used = {r["status"] for r in index_rows}
    check(
        statuses_used <= DOMAIN_STATUS or statuses_used == {"success"},
        f"index.csv status column is mixed/invalid: {sorted(statuses_used)}",
    )
    check(
        not (statuses_used & {"rejected", "failed", "error", "duplicate"}),
        "index.csv contains failure statuses",
    )
    targets = [r["target_path"] for r in index_rows]
    check(len(targets) == len(set(targets)), "index.csv repeats a target_path")
    check(
        all(Path(t).parent.as_posix() == "normalized" for t in targets),
        "index.csv target_path is not under normalized/",
    )
    check(
        all((WS / t).is_file() for t in targets),
        "index.csv points at a missing normalized file",
    )
    check(
        all(r["source_path"] in inputs for r in index_rows),
        "index.csv references a non-input source_path",
    )

    # ---------------- normalized/*.json ----------------
    actual_files = sorted(p.relative_to(WS).as_posix() for p in NORMALIZED.rglob("*") if p.is_file())
    check(actual_files == sorted(targets), "normalized/ file set differs from index.csv targets")
    check(
        all(p.suffix == ".json" for p in NORMALIZED.rglob("*") if p.is_file()),
        "normalized/ contains a non-JSON file",
    )

    records: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for row in index_rows:
        path = WS / row["target_path"]
        try:
            record = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            check(False, f"{row['target_path']}: invalid JSON ({exc})")
            continue
        name = path.name
        match = pattern.fullmatch(name)
        check(bool(match), f"{name}: does not match output_name pattern")
        if match:
            check(match.group("record_type") == row["record_type"], f"{name}: record_type vs filename")
            check(match.group("record_id") == row["record_id"], f"{name}: record_id vs filename")
        check(isinstance(record, dict), f"{name}: top level is not an object")
        record_type = record.get("record_type")
        check(record_type == row["record_type"], f"{name}: record_type mismatch")
        expected = EXPECTED_KEYS.get(record_type, set())
        keys = set(record)
        check(keys == expected or keys == expected | {"source_path"}, f"{name}: unexpected key set {sorted(keys)}")
        check(record.get("record_id") == row["record_id"], f"{name}: record_id mismatch")
        check(record.get("record_id") in EXPECTED_VALUES, f"{name}: unexpected record_id")
        if record_type == "order":
            amount = record.get("amount")
            check(
                isinstance(amount, (int, float)) and not isinstance(amount, bool),
                f"{name}: amount is not a JSON number ({amount!r})",
            )
            check(record.get("status") == ORDER_STATUS, f"{name}: order status must be 'active'")
            check(record.get("currency") in rules["currencies"], f"{name}: currency outside rules")
        else:
            check(
                record.get("status") in statuses,
                f"{name}: status {record.get('status')!r} not in rules statuses",
            )
        for key, expected_value in EXPECTED_VALUES.get(record.get("record_id"), {}).items():
            check(
                record.get(key) == expected_value,
                f"{name}: {key} = {record.get(key)!r}, expected {expected_value!r}",
            )
        check(record.get("record_id") not in records, f"{name}: duplicate normalized record_id")
        records[record.get("record_id")] = record

    check(len(records) == len(index_rows), "index rows and unique normalized records disagree")

    # ---------------- reject_ledger.csv ----------------
    rheader, reject_rows = read_csv(REJECTS)
    check(
        rheader == ["source_path", "error_type", "details"],
        f"reject_ledger.csv header mismatch: {rheader}",
    )
    check(
        [r["source_path"] for r in reject_rows] == sorted(r["source_path"] for r in reject_rows),
        "reject_ledger.csv rows are not sorted by source_path",
    )
    check(
        {r["error_type"] for r in reject_rows} <= ALLOWED_ERRORS,
        f"reject_ledger.csv uses disallowed error_type(s): "
        f"{sorted({r['error_type'] for r in reject_rows} - ALLOWED_ERRORS)}",
    )
    check(
        all(r["source_path"] in inputs for r in reject_rows),
        "reject_ledger.csv references a non-input source_path",
    )
    check(
        all((r["details"] or "").strip() for r in reject_rows),
        "reject_ledger.csv has an empty details field",
    )
    # A rejected record must not produce a normalized file, and a source that
    # only has rejects must not appear in index.csv.
    indexed_sources = {r["source_path"] for r in index_rows}
    for row in reject_rows:
        if row["error_type"] == "unsupported_extension":
            check(row["source_path"] not in indexed_sources, f"{row['source_path']}: unsupported file indexed")

    # ---------------- batch_summary.json ----------------
    summary = json.loads(SUMMARY.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    check(set(summary) == {"success_count", "reject_count", "by_type"}, f"batch_summary keys: {sorted(summary)}")
    check(summary.get("success_count") == len(index_rows), "success_count != index.csv rows")
    check(summary.get("success_count") == len(actual_files), "success_count != normalized file count")
    check(summary.get("reject_count") == len(reject_rows), "reject_count != reject_ledger.csv rows")
    by_type = summary.get("by_type")
    check(isinstance(by_type, dict) and set(by_type) == {"customer", "order", "note"}, f"by_type keys: {by_type}")
    for kind in ("customer", "order", "note"):
        counted = sum(1 for r in records.values() if r.get("record_type") == kind)
        check(by_type.get(kind) == counted, f"by_type[{kind}] = {by_type.get(kind)}, actual {counted}")
    check(sum(by_type.values()) == summary["success_count"], "by_type does not sum to success_count")

    # ---------------- coverage & expectation table ----------------
    all_ledger_sources = indexed_sources | {r["source_path"] for r in reject_rows}
    check(all_ledger_sources == set(inputs), f"input coverage mismatch: missing={sorted(set(inputs) - all_ledger_sources)} extra={sorted(all_ledger_sources - set(inputs))}")

    accepted_by_source: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for row in index_rows:
        accepted_by_source.setdefault(row["source_path"], []).append(row["record_id"])
    for source, ids in EXPECTED_ACCEPT.items():
        check(accepted_by_source.get(source, []) == ids, f"{source}: accepted {accepted_by_source.get(source, [])} != expected {ids}")
    for source in EXPECTED_ACCEPT:
        check(source not in {r["source_path"] for r in reject_rows if r["error_type"] == "unsupported_extension"}, f"{source}: wrongly rejected as unsupported")

    rejected_by_source: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for row in reject_rows:
        rejected_by_source.setdefault(row["source_path"], []).append(row["error_type"])
    for source, errors in EXPECTED_REJECT.items():
        check(rejected_by_source.get(source, []) == errors, f"{source}: rejects {rejected_by_source.get(source, [])} != expected {errors}")
    check(
        sum(len(v) for v in rejected_by_source.values()) == len(reject_rows),
        "reject rows do not match expectation table",
    )

    # ---------------- report ----------------
    print(f"checks run : {checks}")
    print(f"failures   : {len(failures)}")
    print(f"accepted   : {len(index_rows)} records / {len(actual_files)} files")
    print(f"rejected   : {len(reject_rows)} rows")
    print(f"by_type    : {by_type}")
    if failures:
        print("\nFAIL")
        for item in failures:
            print("  -", item)
        return 1
    print("\nPASS: artifacts satisfy the contract and the expectation table")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
